vmid.description: Unique numeric identifier for the VM across the cluster.

name.description: Human-readable name for the VM; used for display in the web UI and tools.

ostype.description: Guest operating system type; influences optimization and driver defaults.

cores.description: Number of virtual CPU cores per socket.

sockets.description: Number of CPU sockets (total vCPUs = sockets × cores).

memory.description: Total RAM allocated to the VM in MiB.

numa.description: Number of NUMA nodes; >0 enables manual NUMA layout.

bootdisk.description: Which disk device serves as the primary boot device.

acpi.description: Enable ACPI support for the guest.

agp.description: Enable AGP support (rarely needed; for legacy Windows).

hpet.description: Enable High Precision Event Timer (HPET); improves timing for some guests.

tpmstate.description: Enable TPM 2.0 device for secure boot and cryptographic operations.

machine.description: QEMU machine type; must be compatible with the host PVE version.

vga.description: Graphics adapter type (e.g., 'std', 'qxl', 'vmware', 'none'); may include resolution like 'serial0=1920x1080'.

disks.description: List of virtual disk devices attached to the VM.

storage.description: Storage pool name (e.g., 'local', 'zfs') where volume resides.

iothread.description: Enable dedicated I/O thread for improved performance.

ssd.description: Treat disk as SSD (enables TRIM/Discard optimizations).

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type for cloud-init or image detection (e.g., 'application/x-qemu-disk').

nics.description: List of network interfaces attached to the VM.

bridge.description: Linux bridge or VM bridge name (e.g., 'vmbr0', 'vmbr1').

rate.description: Bandwidth limit in Mbps (e.g., '100' for 100 Mbps).

queues.description: Number of TX/RX queues (for multi-queue virtio).

trunks.description: VLAN trunks (list of VLAN IDs or '0-4095' for all).

hostid.description: Host-specific ID for PCI passthrough isolation (16-char hex).

searchdomain.description: Default DNS search domain for the guest.

rng_devices.description: List of random number generator devices (usually 0 or 1).

source.description: Entropy source (e.g., '/dev/urandom'); leave blank for default.

args.description: Additional raw QEMU command-line arguments (e.g., '-cpu host').

description.description: Free-form description or notes about this VM (supports multi-line text).

tags.description: List of tags to apply for grouping or automation (e.g., ['prod', 'web']).

hookscript.description: Path to hook script (e.g., '/var/lib/vz/snippets/hookscript.sh') for lifecycle events.

scsi_controllers.description: List of SCSI controllers to add (needed for >4 disks or advanced config).

usb_devices.description: USB devices passed through to the VM.

volume_id.description: For USB mass storage: volume ID in 'storage:volume' format.

numa_nodes.description: Detailed NUMA node layout (only used if 'numa_enabled' is true).

memory.description: Memory (MiB) allocated to this NUMA node.

discard.description: Allow discard of unused memory pages.
